argumentation_roles.lesson: Use one raw-shape panel, one engineered-feature separability panel and one confusion/per-class metric panel. A feature heatmap should support selection, not replace grouped validation.
Prefer aligned small multiples with common axes plus held-out-temperature residual/relative-error panels; do not infer generalization from fitted curves alone.
Main-effect boxplots are descriptive. For interactions, add covariate-adjusted marginal means/contrasts with confidence intervals after controlling log f and log Bm.
A 12-regime model needs a parameter-consistency table generated from code plus held-out group error distribution; a few point predictions do not establish generalization.
Show feasible-domain/Pareto evidence, selected operating point, constraint margins and model-support distance. A convergence curve or one point cannot prove bi-objective optimality.
